subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw require signed/notarized macOS desktop assets plus `appcast-beta.xml` for beta release trains, or keep beta npm/git releases allowed without macOS app artifacts?
rationale: The requested state conflicts with current public beta-channel docs and needs private signing/notary/Sparkle release credentials, so automation cannot safely choose the release policy.

options.title: Require signed beta desktop distribution
options.body: Land or replace the related source and release-infra work, then run the private macOS validate/preflight/publish sequence before treating beta publish as complete.

options.title: Keep beta desktop optional
options.body: Leave beta npm/git publication policy as-is and document that this old beta train will not receive desktop assets or a beta appcast.

options.title: Defer to a future beta train
options.body: Keep this tracker open only until a maintainer chooses a newer canonical beta train and closes this older train as superseded by that release plan.

recommendation.title: Require signed beta desktop distribution
recommendation.body: Land or replace the related source and release-infra work, then run the private macOS validate/preflight/publish sequence before treating beta publish as complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is release-policy and signing-infrastructure owned, and this account has appcast/release-process history plus central project routing evidence.
